neighbours.label: inner subword piece of an unfamiliar foreign proper name (A|iken|head, A|icha, Bad|en)
fire: The lecture was given by Professor Aikenhead of Saskatchewan.
My neighbour Aicha brought us a plate of pastries.
We spent a weekend at the spa town of Baden near Vienna.
The report was signed by Dr. Ichikawa and two colleagues.
Last night I read a long essay by Michiko Kakutani.
The archive holds letters from the poet Eichendorff.
A footballer named Hasselbaink scored twice in the final.
The village of Aikenhead lies a few miles from the coast.
quiet: The lecture was given by Professor Morgan of Saskatchewan.
My neighbour Susan brought us a plate of pastries.
We spent a weekend at the spa town of Bath near Bristol.
The report was signed by Dr. Taylor and two colleagues.
Last night I read a long essay by Michael Lewis.
The archive holds letters from the poet Wordsworth.
A footballer named Johnson scored twice in the final.
The village of Ashford lies a few miles from the coast.

notes: Peaks on pieces like 'iken','ichi','en' inside names. Probe: Aicha 1.6, Aikenhead 0.9, Smith 0.03.
